disclaimer: Prices are per person in US dollars as shown on the linked page when checked. Nothing here is booked.

activities.name: Night kayak & bioluminescence, Lac Bay
activities.desc: Guided evening paddle through the Lac Bay mangroves; the water glows with bioluminescent plankton with every paddle stroke. Dry bag, underwater lamp and a drink at the end are included.
activities.price: US$75 per adult per the tour page (one page shows from US$80); kids 5-11 $56
activities.days: Wednesdays and Thursdays, 7-9 PM. On your trip: Wed Nov 11 or Thu Nov 12. Best near the new moon (darkest nights), which matches your week.
activities.couple: Very romantic and calm; a drink is included at the end.
activities.physical: Easy paddling, sea level, fine after diving. Bring bug spray, light long sleeves, your own drinking water, cash, and your STINAPA nature fee receipt.

photo.credit: Photo: Mike · CC BY-SA 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo shows bioluminescence generally, not Lac Bay.

activities.note: Free cancellation up to 47 hours before the tour. Not booked.

activities.name: Underwater scooter (DPV) course
activities.desc: PADI DPV Specialty: learn to ride an underwater scooter, with 2 scooter dives included. Once certified you can rent DPVs and scoot on your own.
activities.price: US$245 incl. eLearning (US$210 if eLearning already done)
activities.couple: Do the course together early in the week, then rent scooters for your own dives.
activities.physical: Certified divers. EEG Boulevard 260, Belnem (south of Kralendijk).

photo.alt: Scuba diver riding an underwater scooter (DPV)
photo.credit: Photo: Olivier Dugornay (IFREMER) · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo shows DPV diving generally, not Bonaire.

activities.name: Guided underwater scooter dive
activities.desc: Guided DPV dives on Piranha scooters for any Open Water diver 12+, no course needed. A 1-day DPV Specialty is also offered.
activities.price: Price not listed online; ask the shop
activities.couple: Easiest way to try scooters with no course.
activities.physical: Open Water divers 12+. J.A. Abraham Blvd 82, a short walk south of the Carib Inn.

photo.alt: Scuba diver riding an underwater scooter (DPV)
photo.credit: Photo: Olivier Dugornay (IFREMER) · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo shows DPV diving generally, not Bonaire.

activities.name: Private DPV course: Lake to Hilma Hooker
activities.desc: Private half-day DPV course with 2 scooter dives along The Lake, past the Hilma Hooker wreck to Angel City.
activities.price: US$225 per diver for the 2 dives + US$146 eLearning (US$371 per diver)
activities.couple: Private, so it goes at your pace; the wreck by scooter is the highlight.
activities.physical: Certified divers. Kaya Antonio Neuman 7, Kralendijk.

photo.alt: Scuba diver riding an underwater scooter (DPV)
photo.credit: Photo: Olivier Dugornay (IFREMER) · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo shows DPV diving generally, not Bonaire.

activities.name: Underwater scooter rental
activities.desc: Dive shop at Harbour Village that PADI lists as offering DPV rental.
activities.price: Price not listed online; ask the shop
activities.physical: Usually needs a DPV card or a check-out dive. Harbour Village, Kaya Gob. N. Debrot 71.

photo.alt: Scuba diver riding an underwater scooter (DPV)
photo.credit: Photo: Olivier Dugornay (IFREMER) · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo shows DPV diving generally, not Bonaire.

activities.name: eFoil (electric surfboard) lesson or ride
activities.desc: Fly above the water on a Fliteboard electric hydrofoil surfboard. Beginner private lessons, guided rides, or solo rental if you're experienced.
activities.price: Beginner private lesson US$150 for 1 / US$250 for 2; guided rental US$140 per 45 min; solo rental (experienced) US$100 per 45 min
activities.couple: The lesson for 2 is the best value.
activities.physical: Balance matters more than strength; you'll fall in a few times. Watersport Center at Corallium Hotel, Kaya International 2. Book via WhatsApp +599 777 6115.

photo.alt: Rider on an electric hydrofoil surfboard (eFoil)
photo.credit: Photo: ITookSomePhotos · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo shows eFoiling generally, not Bonaire.

activities.name: Fliteboard eFoil session with coaching
activities.desc: Solo or duo Fliteboard eFoil sessions with coaching. They also rent a Seascooter (small underwater scooter for snorkeling).
activities.price: Prices not listed online; ask the shop
activities.days: Mon-Sat, 9 AM-5 PM per their contact page
activities.physical: Kaya Korsow 1, Kralendijk. Shop phone +599 785 8082.

photo.alt: Rider on an electric hydrofoil surfboard (eFoil)
photo.credit: Photo: ITookSomePhotos · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo shows eFoiling generally, not Bonaire.

activities.name: Mangrove kayak & snorkel (day)
activities.desc: Short intro at the center, then kayak the mangrove tunnels of Lac Bay; the 2-hour version adds a snorkel stop in the baby-fish nursery.
activities.price: US$45 (1 h) · US$60 (2 h with snorkel) per person
activities.couple: Easy, shaded, good photo spot.
activities.physical: Easy. Sea level. Bring bug spray and cash for the mini shop.

photo.credit: Photo: Adamboluu · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.name: Bioluminescence ('glow') night snorkel by boat
activities.desc: Night boat trip to snorkel in the dark and watch tiny organisms flash blue-green around you.
activities.price: US$99 per person
activities.days: Evenings, about 7 PM departure. The glow show is strongest a few nights after the full moon, so ask the operator which nights to go.
activities.couple: Unusual shared experience; small groups.
activities.physical: Surface snorkel only, fine on diving days.

photo.credit: Photo: W.carter · CC0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Generic bioluminescence photo, not this tour.

activities.name: Woodwind sunset snorkel sail
activities.desc: Trimaran sail along the coast with one guided drift-snorkel at Klein Bonaire, then sunset with open bar, snacks and a warm local lunch/meal.
activities.price: US$85 per adult
activities.days: Sunset trip runs Fridays, 3:30 PM, from the Divi Flamingo south dock (check other day sails on their site)
activities.couple: Classic couples' evening.
activities.physical: Light snorkel; STINAPA tag required.

photo.credit: Photo: RCraig09 · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo is a generic Bonaire sunset with a sailboat.

activities.name: Klein Bonaire water taxi & beach day
activities.desc: Hop over to uninhabited Klein Bonaire for No Name Beach: powdery sand, turtles and great snorkeling. Pack shade and water, there are no services.
activities.price: US$25 round trip per person (snorkel gear +$5, chair +$5)
activities.duration: Half or full day, your choice
activities.days: Several departures daily from the marina
activities.couple: Easy, relaxed beach day for two.
activities.physical: Sun exposure is intense; reef-safe sunscreen. Fine after diving.

photo.alt: Klein Bonaire water taxi & beach day
photo.credit: Photo: dronepicr · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.name: Parrot nature tour at Echo (Dos Pos)
activities.desc: Guided walk in the green Dos Pos valley to see wild yellow-shouldered parrots (lora) and meet two ambassador parrots. Fees fund parrot conservation.
activities.price: US$25 per adult
activities.days: Weekdays 9 AM; 48 h notice, minimum 2 people, cash only; book by WhatsApp (on their page)
activities.couple: Perfect for two (meets the 2-person minimum).
activities.physical: Easy walk on rough ground; sturdy shoes, water, bug spray.

photo.alt: Parrot nature tour at Echo (Dos Pos)
photo.credit: Photo: Atsme (Betty Wills) · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.name: Donkey Sanctuary
activities.desc: Drive-through sanctuary caring for 500+ rescued donkeys; drive slowly, windows down, and they come to say hi. Also a visitor center and shop.
activities.price: US$9 per adult
activities.days: Daily 10 AM-4 PM, last entry 3 PM; tickets at the gate, no booking
activities.couple: Fun and silly; buy carrot pellets at the entrance.
activities.physical: Easy, in your car. Fine any day.

photo.credit: Photo: Serge Melki from Indianapolis, USA · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo shows wild Bonaire donkeys, not the sanctuary.

activities.name: Flamingo viewing (Pekelmeer & Gotomeer)
activities.desc: Pink flamingos feed in the salt ponds in the south (Pekelmeer, viewed from the road; the breeding sanctuary itself is closed) and at Gotomeer lake in the north.
activities.price: Free
activities.days: Any day; early morning or late afternoon light is best
activities.couple: Bring binoculars and a long lens.
activities.physical: Stay on the road; no entry to the sanctuary. Fine after diving.

photo.credit: Photo: Adamboluu · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.note: No booking needed. Info link is bonaire.com (tourism guide).

activities.name: Gotomeer lookout & 1000-step north drive
activities.desc: Scenic north-coast road to the Gotomeer lake overlook with flamingos, past cliffs and turquoise dive coves.
activities.price: Free
activities.couple: Easy drive with lots of photo stops.
activities.physical: Normal car OK. Fine after diving (no high altitude anywhere on Bonaire).

photo.credit: Photo: Paul Arps from The Netherlands · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.note: No booking; info link is bonaire.com.

activities.name: South loop: slave huts, salt pier & pink salt pans
activities.desc: Flat coastal loop past the white and red slave huts (sobering history), the Salt Pier, the pink salt pans and the Willemstoren lighthouse.
activities.price: Free
activities.couple: Pair it with lunch at Lac Bay / Sorobon.
activities.physical: Very hot midday; take water. Fine after diving.

photo.alt: South loop: slave huts, salt pier & pink salt pans
photo.credit: Photo: Paul Arps from The Netherlands · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.note: No booking; info link is bonaire.com.

activities.name: Seru Largu lookout
activities.desc: Short drive up behind Kralendijk to a hilltop with a panoramic view over town, Klein Bonaire and the coast; lovely at sunset.
activities.price: Free
activities.couple: Easy sunset spot for two.
activities.physical: The hill is only about 100 m (330 ft) high, which is not an altitude problem after diving.

photo.credit: Photo: Bgabel · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.note: No official page; info link is bonaire.com.

activities.name: Washington Slagbaai National Park (self-drive)
activities.desc: Wild northern park with cactus desert, blowholes, flamingo lakes, hidden beaches and Brandaris hill. Choose the short or long route.
activities.price: Covered by STINAPA nature fee (US$40 per person per year, cashless)
activities.days: Open Tue-Sun 8 AM-5 PM; last entry 2:30 PM; CLOSED MONDAYS
activities.couple: Bring a picnic and snorkel gear for Boka Slagbaai.
activities.physical: High-clearance or 4x4 recommended (rough, rocky roads). Hiking Brandaris (241 m / ~790 ft) right after diving is a mild altitude change; save it for a non-dive or last-dive-done day.

photo.credit: Photo: Paul Asman and Jill Lenoble · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.note: STINAPA's site timed out from our server; hours confirmed via search snippet of that page.

activities.name: Washington Park tour with local guide
activities.desc: Let a local guide drive the rough park roads and tell the stories; pickup and AC vehicle included.
activities.price: US$112 per person
activities.couple: No 4x4 rental needed.
activities.physical: Easy; sea-level stops.

photo.alt: Washington Park tour with local guide
photo.credit: Photo: Andrawaag · CC0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.note: Book via WhatsApp/email listed on their site.

activities.name: Cadushy Distillery tasting, Rincon
activities.desc: Bonaire's only distillery, in an old cinema in Rincon: see how the cactus liqueur and Rom Rincon are made, then taste in the garden bar.
activities.price: Free entry, tour and tasting
activities.days: Mon-Sat 10 AM-5 PM; Sunday check their social media
activities.couple: Fun stop on a north-island day.
activities.physical: If tasting, the non-diver drives. Don't drink before diving.

photo.credit: Photo: Bgabel · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo shows Rincon village, not the distillery.

activities.name: Food & bar-hopping walking tour
activities.desc: Evening walk through Kralendijk with four drinks, four appetizers, a main course and dessert at local spots.
activities.price: US$110 per person (shown on bonaire.com listing)
activities.couple: Great date night.
activities.physical: Includes alcohol; skip an early dive the next morning if you indulge.

photo.credit: Photo: Senor Luis Bertran · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.note: Price read on bonaire.com (tourism booking site), not the operator page.

activities.name: Cave tour (dry caves + snorkel cave)
activities.desc: Local guide takes you to three caves with stalactites and one fresh-water cave you swim/snorkel in. Pickup included.
activities.price: US$77 per person (2+ people)
activities.couple: Adventurous couples love it.
activities.physical: Crawling and uneven rock; bring dry clothes. Sea level, fine after diving.

photo.credit: Photo: JERRYE AND ROY KLOTZ MD · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo is a Bonaire coastal cave, not the tour caves.

activities.name: Land sailing (blokart)
activities.desc: Race a three-wheeled wind-powered kart around a track on the windy east coast; no experience needed.
activities.price: US$60 per person (45 min on track)
activities.couple: Side-by-side racing, very fun for two.
activities.physical: Low effort. Fine after diving.

photo.credit: Photo: Finn ped · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.note: Operator site blocks automated checks; price from bonaire.com listing. Photo is blokarts elsewhere.

activities.name: East coast UTV / ATV tour
activities.desc: 2.5-hour guided off-road ride on the wild east coast to the Spelonk lighthouse, caves and Indian drawings.
activities.price: From US$95 (UTV two-seater) · from US$140 (ATV/UTV combo)
activities.days: Mon, Thu, Sat at 09:00 and 13:00 (other days on request)
activities.couple: Two-seater UTV fits a couple.
activities.physical: Bumpy and dusty. Sea level.

photo.credit: Photo: Andrej Danković · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.note: Operator site blocks automated checks; price from search snippet of their page. Generic ATV photo.

activities.name: Horseback riding (Flamingo or Beach ride)
activities.desc: Guided trail rides through countryside and mangroves; the beach ride stops at Lac Cai.
activities.price: US$75 (Flamingo tour, 1.5 h) · US$150 (Beach ride, 3.5 h)
activities.couple: Sunset ride is a nice couples' outing.
activities.physical: Rider weight limit 80 kg (176 lb); includes trotting/galloping.

photo.credit: Photo: James Emery from Douglasville, United States · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Generic beach-ride photo, not Bonaire.

activities.name: Windsurf lesson at Lac Bay
activities.desc: Learn on the shallow, flat, warm water of Lac Bay, one of the best beginner windsurf spots in the world.
activities.price: US$50 per person (Beginner I, 2 h)
activities.couple: Take the lesson together.
activities.physical: Physical but shallow water. Fine after diving.

photo.credit: Photo: dronepicr · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized

activities.name: Kitesurf lesson at Atlantis Beach
activities.desc: IKO-certified beginner lessons at Atlantis beach in the south, in steady trade winds.
activities.price: US$290 (beginner lesson, 3 h)
activities.couple: Pricey and strenuous; better as a one-person treat.
activities.physical: Strenuous; don't plan right after a long dive day.

photo.credit: Photo: Vyacheslav Argenberg · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Generic kitesurf photo (Vietnam), not Bonaire.

activities.name: Guided mountain-bike tour
activities.desc: Guided ride on desert trails among cacti and coastal views.
activities.price: US$25 per person (guide) + bike rental extra
activities.couple: Meets the 2-person minimum.
activities.physical: Hot and hilly but low elevation. Go early.

photo.credit: Photo: mypubliclands · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Photo is a desert trail in Arizona, not Bonaire.

activities.name: Thai yoga massage
activities.desc: Traditional Thai yoga massage at a small local studio; they offer a 2-session package that works as one for each of us.
activities.price: US$90 single · US$150 for 2 sessions
activities.days: Book via WhatsApp on their page; cash or PayPal
activities.couple: 2-session price works for a couple.
activities.physical: Gentle; a good rest-day treat.

photo.credit: Photo: Tara Angkor Hotel · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Generic Thai massage photo.

activities.name: Beach & spa day pass
activities.desc: Day pass with pools, beach bed, towel, water and a 50-minute beach-spa massage.
activities.price: US$120 per adult
activities.couple: Easy pampering day.
activities.physical: Rest day after diving.

photo.credit: Photo: Tara Angkor Hotel · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons · resized
photo.caption: Generic massage photo, not Delfins.
